messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a 'SLO-aware fallback runbook' in the console. Need UX that lets SREs define graceful handoffs based on latency/availability/quality/quota. Thoughts?

Tom: 👍 what's the minimum primitives we need? a trigger, a target route, a sampling policy, and an audit trace.

li: agree; add a 'soft-mode' that routes X% of traffic to fallback before full cutover. UI should expose that percent and a ramp schedule.

ajay: Re: sampling — do we surface request samples inline or only a link to playback? Security concerns for PII.

maria: Good point. Proposal: sample IDs + scrubbed payload snippet + link to replay sandbox (VPC-safe). Also flag samples that were fully redacted.

elaine: UI wise we should show an expected cost delta and estimated latency change for the fallback route (per 1k requests). Helps PM/finance signoff.

Tom: Also surface the confidence metric from evals: if fallback model quality drops below threshold, block auto-fallback. Maybe a hard stop rule.

infra-bot: deploy 1739-fallback-runbook-service started by @infra (watch logs at /deploys/1739)

ops-bot: incident alert: region-us-west-2 latency spike — p99 > 1.2s, error-rate 1.6% (auto-notify)

maria: imagine policy DSL like:
```
when latency.p99 > 800ms for 5m
and error_rate > 1%
then route 20% -> fallback-model quantized-3b
lock if quality.delta < -0.05
audit enable full
```

li: nice. Where does quota exhaustion fit? should be a separate trigger type (quota.remaining_per_customer < 5% etc).

ajay: I'd prefer 'quota' triggers to be able to scale fallbacks by customer tier — e.g., enterprise keeps primary, free tiers fall back faster. We need per-customer policies.

elaine: UX: show a timeline simulation graph with traffic split slider; allow 'dry-run' to run on real telemetry without routing changes, and show predicted outcomes.

maria: Important: audit trail must be queryable by request-id, include decision reason, policy snapshot, actors (auto vs manual), and playback link. Also immutable policy hashes for repro.

sam: one more ask: the runbook page should surface previous rollouts + rollbacks with success metrics and regression flags (did quality improve/worsen).

maria: ok action items: tom + li prototype a policy editor wireframe; ajay design sampling & PII scrub rules; infra to add a dry-run API. Can we land a tiny MVP for Q2?

Tom: will do. filing a quick Figma and a PoC API stub today.

li: i'll add sample telemetry hooks and a mock audit API (will push a swagger).

maria: also want a small in-console checklist: preflight checks (eval score, cost delta, rollout % default, retention policy).

elaine: cc @pm-kate for prioritization — need product's call on default percent and enterprise exemptions.

pm-kate: thanks — will sync with growth and legal about quotas & PII policy, aiming for a decision by next Wed.

maria: thanks all. nudging PM to prioritise. :sparkles:

elaine: can we add an opt-out toggle per-customer that operators can flip in emergencies? keeps manual override easy.

Tom: add to backlog: operator-override + timeline + reason field (required) for audit.

maria: sweet. closing notes: try to keep the first MVP small: (1) trigger types: latency/error/quota; (2) soft-mode ramp; (3) dry-run + audit entries; (4) PII-safe samples. We'll iterate on quality gating after initial telemetry.
